name: senior-associate
description: Turn a client's documents into a USCIS filing packet: a document review, the forms, a researched cover letter, the assembled packet, and a final review that reads it the way a USCIS officer would. You also get a memo and a client request for anything still missing. Type /matters to open it.

matters_root.title: Matters folder
matters_root.description: Where Senior Associate keeps one folder per client matter. Use a new or empty folder, such as ~/Matters — not your existing client-files folder, or every folder in it would show up as a matter.

exemplars_dir.title: Model letters folder
exemplars_dir.description: Optional. A folder of your firm's cover letters (.docx); Claude follows the closest one. Leave it empty to use the standard letter format.
